about_the_game:
TSW Compatible content released for a previous Train Sim World® - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features.

Discover different freight services with Skyhook Games’ Cargo Line for Train Sim World®. In Volume 3, contain your excitement as you haul intermodal freight as part of the global distribution chain - metal boxes sat upon all new FCA flats await transportation across the UK.

Climb aboard Class 66 traction and get to work across the UK’s distribution industry. Featuring the modern FCA spine wagon, take on the task of moving heavy trains across passenger main lines. Keep the wheelspin under control and always be several steps ahead!

The FCA intermodal spine wagon was introduced to the UK in the year 2000. This fleet of approximately 400 wagons, arranged in coupled pairs, are capable of being laden with a variety of container-based loads and are found across the country. Ships bring containers in by sea, and export them abroad, but the journey between port and customer is done by rail. In Train Sim World®, the FCA wagons feature dynamic container loads with containers of various sizes and colours.

Across a new selection of scenarios, take on the task of hauling containers along the two major backbones of Britian, the East Coast and West Coast Main Lines. Run between London Euston commuter traffic, and hurry through the Midlands as Azumas race by. Each route has a dedicated version of their timetables, swapping out default FKA-only container freight with realistic mixes of FCA and FKA trains. Previous Cargo Line content is also featured in these timetables.

With Free Roam and Formation Designer, unpack the action and embark across any route of your choosing. Put your fleet of locomotives to the test on the ever-present flow of distribution freight!

Please Note: For the full experience, we recommend you own Train Sim World®: ECML: Peterborough - Doncaster and WCML: London Euston - Milton Keynes which are available as separate purchases.

Key Features

  • FCA intermodal spine wagon in EWS Maroon livery

  • Dynamic variations of container colours and sizes

  • BR Class 66 locomotive in DB Cargo UK Red livery

  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cab

  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling

  • 3x scenarios each for ECML: Peterborough - Doncaster and WCML: London Euston - Milton Keynes

  • Dedicated Cargo Line Vol. 3 version of each route’s timetables

  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club

  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology

  • Download size: 217.3 MB
